summary: Allocates a 108-byte list node, zero-initializes it, validates it with FlagConditionalBranchDispatch, and appends it to the tail of a singly-linked list stored at this+0x148 (head) with next pointers at node+0x68 and a back-pointer at node+0x64. On validation failure the node is freed and the output pointer a2 is zeroed. On success the node count at this+0x144 is incremented, a2 receives the new node, and the return value encodes whether the per-node VertexBufferResourceAllocation succeeded.

operations.description: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(108) allocates the 108-byte node; when it returns null the node pointer stays 0.
StructZeroInitWithDefaults zero-initializes the freshly allocated node.
FlagConditionalBranchDispatch(node, a3) validates the new node; a nonzero result selects the failure path.
On failure EmptyStub_7470 is invoked and then FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the node.
On failure the output pointer a2, when present, is set to 0.
If the list head this[82] (offset 0x148) is zero the new node becomes the head; otherwise walk to the tail.
Walk node next pointers at node+0x68 until the last node of the list is reached.
Append the new node: the tail's next pointer at node+0x68 is set to the new node and the new node's back-pointer v5[25] (0x64) points back to the tail.
Increment the node count at this+0x144.
On success the output pointer a2, when present, receives the new node.
Return 0 when VertexBufferResourceAllocation succeeds, otherwise -1 (the nonzero result is negated); called by sub_4CB120 and UIListNodeManager (0054BB40).

unresolved: The meaning of the a3 argument passed to FlagConditionalBranchDispatch is not established from this packet.
Why a nonzero VertexBufferResourceAllocation result makes the function return -1 is unexplained here.
The owning class behind the count/head fields this+0x144 and this+0x148 is unknown.
this+0x1B0 is listed in the packet fields but has no direct occurrence in the raw decompiled source; the field evidence for the node next pointer is expressed through it.
